name: Skateboard
summary: Skateboard with a curved deck, two trucks and four wheels, in side view facing right; a small hero prop.

params.name: y
params.note: ground line: the wheels touch y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 520 px wide (hero size)

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the board bobs (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the board faces left

author: krakujs
